notes.title: 2025 Gameshow Recap & Huge Thanks!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Dreamdivers![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217848/bc9f6128e8551149403b85deffaf64445edfc783.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our team is back from an incredible journey over the past few months. From March to August, we had the opportunity to showcase the INTERSCAPE demo at three major events: [b]GDC, ChinaJoy, and Gamescom! [/b]It was a privilege to share our creation on these global stages. [/p][p][/p][p]Most importantly, to every single one of you who visited our booths, played the demo, and shared your invaluable feedback – thank you, from the bottom of our hearts. Seeing your reactions and hearing your thoughts in person is the ultimate motivation for our development. The support you showed us means the world.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, we are back and focused on development. We've returned more inspired than ever and can't wait to show you what's next. We’ll be back with more specific development news soon. Please look forward to it![/p][p][/p][p]The ROOMTONE Team[/p]

notes.title: First Announcement & An Important Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45217848/a63c4834fe41451403ffbd0340aeae61081f6d55.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello Dreamdivers,[/p][p][/p][p]This is the ROOMTONE team, developers of INTERSCAPE. It’s a pleasure to finally connect with you all for our first official announcement![/p][p][/p][p]First things first, we have important news to share: the game formerly known as 'Dream in the Shell' has now been renamed to '[b]INTERSCAPE[/b]'. We sincerely apologize for the delay in this update. This was a necessary step to secure a unique trademark and find a name that truly fits the world we're building.[/p][p][/p][p]While the title is new, the game is not. [b]The core vision and gameplay are unchanged.[/b] We're still making the same experience you wishlisted.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been quiet, but busy! Development is pushing forward, and we’ve just returned from showcasing the game at GDC, ChinaJoy, and Gamescom (following up on Tokyo Game Show last year). Stay tuned for a recap from these events soon! We are committed to posting more regular updates here on Steam from now on.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being our first supporters. Your wishlist means the world to our small team. [/p][p]We’re excited to continue this journey with you as INTERSCAPE![/p][p][/p][p]The ROOMTONE Team[/p]
